messages:
maya: quick sync — proposing a structured plan for recruiting trial partners for the new 'Snapshots' feature. want to align on target profile, incentives, feedback cadence, and launch criteria. TL;DR: aim for 12 active partners over 8 weeks, mix of platform + product teams, weekly 30-min feedback calls, telemetry + structured surveys, and 3 sign-off gates. thoughts?

chris: +1 on the cadence. can we split targets into 'integration-ready' vs 'console-only'? makes outreach easier.

maya: yes — integration-ready (API/SDK) and console-only (UI). target 7 integration, 5 console.

jess: from design POV we need at least 2 customers who will do screen-sharing sessions so we can iterate UI flows quickly.

tom: engineering asks: require a minimal SDK + feature-flag rollout path. we can support 7 integration partners concurrently if they commit to a short onboarding checklist. latency SLOs need to be in scope for success metrics.

alex: solutions can handle outreach to existing customers on enterprise plans. propose we also tap two open-source maintainers who integrate with our runtime.

lina: research recommends structured pre/post surveys + 3 canonical tasks we observe partners run. that gives quant metrics (task completion, time-to-first-success, CSAT).

maya: proposed incentives: 3 months of free dedicated capacity credits (or equivalent hosted credits), priority support, co-marketing for 2 partners, and early access to performance tuning. is that reasonable?

chris: reasonable. add an optional small stipend for customers who do weekly labs and recorded sessions. increases commitment.

legal-bot: reminder: NDA template v4.2 must be used for pilots involving customer data. if partners want telemetry on private datasets we need Data Processing Addendum signed.

maya: noted. we'll coordinate with legal for DPAs. quick product constraint: we will not allow training on customer data; only aggregate telemetry for product improvements. must be explicit in outreach.

jess: scope negotiation: ship 1) read-only snapshot export, 2) live diff viewer in console, 3) API to fetch snapshots. we should scope MVP to read/export + console viewer. delay live diff API unless a partner requests it.

tom: agree. MVP engineering scope = export + viewer + SDK hook to opt-in telemetry. estimate ~5 sprint-weeks with two engineers full time.

maya: success metrics (proposal): at least 9/12 partners complete onboarding within 2 weeks; average weekly active use >= 3 sessions; median snapshot render < 300ms; actionability score (survey) >= 4/5; two partners convert to paid dedicated contracts within 6 months.

lina: add regression guard: no more than 2 critical bugs per partner in first 30 days. collect NPS-like score at week 4.

alex: ops note: need a playbook for rollbacks and safe defaults. if any partner hits errors we should auto-fallback to previous viewer and alert SRE. also add cost guardrail for exporting large snapshots.

chris: recruiting plan — outreach channels: 1) account execs to enterprise customers, 2) product newsletter call-for-partners, 3) direct outreach to OSS integrators, 4) referrals from solutions. target outreach list of 40, goal convert 30% -> 12 partners.

maya: timeline: week 0–1 refine materials + NDA, week 2–4 outreach and screening, week 5–12 onboarding + weekly feedback, week 13 review + decide go/no-go.

jess: materials we need: short playbook, onboarding checklist, privacy FAQ, 30-min session guide, and a script for recordings. i'll draft the playbook.

tom: engineering deliverables: SDK opt-in flag, snapshot-export endpoint, viewer component, telemetry toggle, and an internal debug mode for partner sessions. i'll put tasks in sprint board.

lina: for feedback loops: propose weekly 30-min partner calls (recorded), biweekly internal sync, and a rolling issues board open to partners for prioritization. also monthly pulse survey.

maya: launch gates: Gate A (onboarding): 12 partners agreed + signed NDAs and DPA where needed; Gate B (quality): median render <300ms, <3 critical bugs across partners, 8/12 positive actionability score; Gate C (business): at least 1 partner verbal + 1 pipeline opportunity for paid Dedicated.

chris: screening rubric suggestion: product fit (snapshot use-case), engineering readiness, internal champion, legal constraints, and exec sponsorship. score 1–5 each; require average >=3.5 to qualify.

legal-bot: also flag customers in regulated industries — may require Private deployment or VPC; include that in screening.

maya: action items: 1) jess draft playbook (due in 3 days), 2) tom scope + ticket estimate (due EOW), 3) chris build outreach list (10 targets by Wed), 4) lina draft surveys and tasks (due in 5 days), 5) maya coordinate NDAs with legal.

jess: I'll share a draft playbook link in #product when ready.

tom: I'll post engineering tickets and include a small runbook for SRE fallback.

chris: starting outreach this afternoon — will ping account owners.

lina: I'll mock survey templates and canonical task scripts.

maya: thanks everyone. booking 30-min kickoff with leads monday 10am. aim to start outreach immediately after materials are ready.

alex: one more ask — can we capture a short 5-min partner testimonial video by week 8? good for later go-to-market.

maya: love that. mark as optional but high priority.

jess: :+1:

chris: noted, will ask partners during screening.

maya: closing note — keep outreach language explicit about data usage, telemetry opt-in, and no-training clause. we want clear expectations up front. good work.
